scope: Harness foundation comparator/provenance plus minimal already-supported Java replay; future feature corpus growth remains pending.

covered: Java Pattern name and ECMAScript-equivalence boundary mutation
coverage_observed.provenance: Generator resolves existing external reference installation, verifies Node22.22.0 and Express5.1/router2.2/path-to-regexp8.4.2, hashes packages and implementation sources, requires committed lock match without automatic installation.

findings.problem: The committed tests never invoke NaruServe or feed an actual Java request/response/trace into a committed reference case comparison. Comparator controls plus metadata loading can pass with no working Java replay at all. Full future-feature replay is not required here, but the foundation needs at least already-supported literal/param baseline replay.
new_tests_needed: Drive a minimal actual NaruServe app/in-memory adapter for committed literal.get, literal.post or param.basic cases, construct actual observation schema, compare to the committed reference case.
Prove a deliberate actual handler/status/trace difference fails through this replay adapter rather than only comparing synthetic JSON controls.
Ensure the ordinary Gradle test path performs those baseline replays without Node/network.
findings.boundary_note: If parent explicitly limits lane to comparator-only helper, AC3 must remain pending and no Java replay sufficiency/requirement completion claim may be made; the complete harness still owes this test.

findings.problem: The user prohibition of JNI is in corpus.boundary.jni but no negative control toggles it; a validator ignoring that field can pass all current tests.
new_tests_needed: Mutate boundary.jni to true and require field-specific validation failure; retain existing regexEngine and ecmascriptRegExpEquivalent controls.

findings.problem: The negative provenance tests cover Express version and package.json digest, but not the Node pin or implementation source digests. A comparator validating only package metadata could ignore stale reference runtime or altered router source.
new_tests_needed: Mutate reference.node and require reference failure.
Mutate a reference.sources router/layer.js or path-to-regexp/dist/index.js SHA256 and require reference failure.
findings.note: Two identical generation runs are also required execution evidence under AC1; no need to install another dependency or force a network test in Gradle.
